dominant: jñāna with adbhuta weight (knowledge as the means-less; wonder at the pathless)
sthayibhava: prasaṅkhyāna (contemplative counting) opening into camatkāra at the non-dual
justification: The ahnika counts — awareness, luminance, causes, forms — and each count lands as knowledge; wonder breaks through at the means-less announcement (v1) and the 'one luminance' (v22), where the path dissolves into the pathless.
